### Cleanup

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
```

### Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggh4x)
library(egg)
library(ggprism)
library(viridis)
```

### Custom Functions

```{r}
custom_stats_unpaired <- function(expression, comp_group, comp1, comp2){
  x <- expression[comp_group == comp1]
  y <- expression[comp_group == comp2]
  
  if(length(x) == 0 | length(y) == 0){
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  result <- wilcox.test(x, y, paired = FALSE)
  return(result$p.value)
}
```

### Color Palettes

```{r}
cp_group <- c("#449489", "#457cd6", "#945F9C", "#e34262")
cp_marker <- c("#5D9A3C", "#2AC6C3", "#CB6CB3", "#E29140")
```

### Load Data

```{r}
data_csf <- read.xlsx(xlsxFile = "../data/data_csf.xlsx")
data_serum <- read.xlsx(xlsxFile = "../data/data_serum.xlsx")
marker_class <- read.xlsx(xlsxFile = "../data/marker_class.xlsx")
md <- readRDS(file = "../data/meta_data.rds")

all_markers <- sort.default(unique(data_csf$Assay))
```

### Reformat Meta Data

```{r}
marker_class <- marker_class %>%
  dplyr::mutate(General.Classification = factor(
    General.Classification,
    levels = c("Signaling Molecules", "Cytokines",
               "Chemokines", "Growth Factors and Others")))

md <- md %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Group = factor(
    Group, levels = c("Control-GBS", "COVID-GBS",
                      "COVID-no-GBS", "Neuropathy-no-GBS")))
```

### Reformat Data

```{r}
data_csf <- data_csf %>%
  dplyr::filter(QC_Warning == "Pass") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Assay) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(scaled_NPX = scale(NPX)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::relocate(scaled_NPX, .after = "NPX") %>%
  
  ### Two Patient_03 Samples in CSF Data in one run (lets average it out)
  dplyr::group_by(PatientID, Assay, Run) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(scaled_NPX = mean(scaled_NPX)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(NPX = mean(NPX)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

data_serum <- data_serum %>%
  dplyr::filter(QC_Warning == "Pass") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Assay) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(scaled_NPX = scale(NPX)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::relocate(scaled_NPX, .after = "NPX")

dual_run_patients_csf <- data_csf %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Run) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(PatientID) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(PatientID) %>%
  dplyr::add_tally() %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(n > 1) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  .$PatientID

dual_run_patients_serum <- data_serum %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Run) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(PatientID) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(PatientID) %>%
  dplyr::add_tally() %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(n > 1) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  .$PatientID
```

### Figure S2A-CSF

```{r}
pc_chosen <- c(1, 2) ### EDIT

PC_x <- paste0("PC", pc_chosen[1])
PC_y <- paste0("PC", pc_chosen[2])

### REFORMAT DATA
data_pca <- data_csf %>%
  dplyr::left_join(md, by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(PatientID %in% dual_run_patients_csf & Run == 2)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Control-GBS",
                                                 "COVID-GBS",
                                                 "COVID-no-GBS",
                                                 "Neuropathy-no-GBS"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("Zurich", "Bern",
                                                   "Hebron", "Santa Pau")))

### Select Markers for PCA with Below LOD Frequencies Below 30%
viable_markers <- data_pca %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Assay, NPX, LOD) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(belowLOD = if_else(NPX < LOD, 1, 0, NA_real_)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Assay) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    belowLOD_count = sum(belowLOD),
    total_count = n()
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(belowLOD_freq = 100 * belowLOD_count / total_count) %>%
  dplyr::filter(belowLOD_freq <= 30) %>%
  .$Assay

### Generate PCA Input Data
data_pca_input <- data_pca %>%
  dplyr::filter(Assay %in% viable_markers) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Cohort, Group, Assay, scaled_NPX) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "Assay", values_from = "scaled_NPX")

### Convert to Matrix
mat_pca_input <- data_pca_input %>%
  dplyr::select(c(PatientID, all_of(viable_markers))) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "PatientID") %>%
  as.matrix()

### Run PCA
pca <- prcomp(mat_pca_input)

### PCA Output
var_explained <- pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)

data_pca_output <- data.frame(PatientID=row.names(pca$x), pca$x)

### Plot PCA
data_plot <- data_pca_output %>%
  dplyr::left_join(md, by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(data_pca_input %>%
                     dplyr::select(PatientID) %>%
                     dplyr::distinct(),
                   by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("Zurich", "Bern", "Hebron", "Santa Pau")))

rect_list_1 <- rep(list(element_rect(fill = "#457cd6")), 1)
rect_list_2 <- rep(list(element_rect(fill = "#945F9C")), 1)
rect_list_3 <- rep(list(element_rect(fill = "#e34262")), 1)
rect_list_4 <- rep(list(element_rect(fill = "#449489")), 1)
rect_list_5 <- rep(list(element_rect(fill = "white")), 1000) ### For the markers

# Combine the lists into a single list
background_fill <- c(rect_list_1, rect_list_2, rect_list_3, rect_list_4, rect_list_5)


p <- ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = get(PC_x), y = get(PC_y))) +
  facet_wrap2(~Group, nrow = 2,
              strip = strip_nested(bleed = FALSE, background_x = background_fill,
                                   text_x = element_text(size = 16.5))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth=.2, col = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth=.2, col = "gray") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Cohort), shape = 21, color = "black", size = 5) +
  coord_fixed() +
  xlab(label = paste0(PC_x, " (", round(100 * var_explained[pc_chosen[1]], digits = 1), "%)")) +
  ylab(label = paste0(PC_y, " (", round(100 * var_explained[pc_chosen[2]], digits = 1), "%)")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cp_marker) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cp_marker) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18)
  )

pdf(file = "../figures/FigureS2A-CSF.pdf", width = 14, height = 6)
print(p)
invisible(dev.off())

rm(data_pca, data_pca_input, data_pca_output, data_plot, mat_pca_input, p,
   pca, var_explained, viable_markers, pc_chosen, PC_x, PC_y, background_fill) # cleanup
rm(list = ls(pattern = "rect_list_")) # cleanup
```

### Figure S2B-CSF

```{r}
pc_chosen <- c(1, 2) ### EDIT

PC_y <- paste0("PC", pc_chosen[2])

### REFORMAT DATA

                                                 "COVID-no-GBS"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("Zurich", "Bern",
                                                   "Hebron", "Santa Pau")))

### Select Markers for PCA with Below LOD Frequencies Below 30%
viable_markers <- data_pca %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Assay, NPX, LOD) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(belowLOD = if_else(NPX < LOD, 1, 0, NA_real_)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Assay) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    belowLOD_count = sum(belowLOD),

  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(belowLOD_freq = 100 * belowLOD_count / total_count) %>%
  dplyr::filter(belowLOD_freq <= 30) %>%
  .$Assay

### Generate PCA Input Data
data_pca_input <- data_pca %>%
  dplyr::filter(Assay %in% viable_markers) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Cohort, Group, Assay, scaled_NPX) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "Assay", values_from = "scaled_NPX")

### Convert to Matrix
mat_pca_input <- data_pca_input %>%
  dplyr::select(c(PatientID, all_of(viable_markers))) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "PatientID") %>%
  as.matrix()

### Run PCA
pca <- prcomp(mat_pca_input)

### PCA Output
var_explained <- pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)

data_pca_output <- data.frame(PatientID=row.names(pca$x), pca$x)

### Plot PCA
data_plot <- data_pca_output %>%
  dplyr::left_join(md, by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(data_pca_input %>%
                     dplyr::select(PatientID) %>%
                     dplyr::distinct(),
                   by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("Zurich", "Bern", "Hebron", "Santa Pau"))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Group %in% c("Control-GBS", "COVID-GBS"))

rect_list_1 <- rep(list(element_rect(fill = "#457cd6")), 1)
rect_list_2 <- rep(list(element_rect(fill = "#945F9C")), 1)
# rect_list_3 <- rep(list(element_rect(fill = "#e34262")), 1)
# rect_list_4 <- rep(list(element_rect(fill = "#449489")), 1)
rect_list_5 <- rep(list(element_rect(fill = "white")), 1000) ### For the markers

# Combine the lists into a single list
background_fill <- c(rect_list_1, rect_list_2, rect_list_5) # rect_list_3, rect_list_4,


p1 <- ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = get(PC_x), y = get(PC_y))) +
  facet_wrap2(~Group, nrow = 1,
              strip = strip_nested(bleed = FALSE, background_x = background_fill,
                                   text_x = element_text(size = 16.5))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth=.2, col = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth=.2, col = "gray") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = `Days.onset.GBS.-.lumbar.puncture`), shape = 21, color = "black", size = 5) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(fill = "Onset to LP (days)") +
  xlab(label = paste0(PC_x, " (", round(100 * var_explained[pc_chosen[1]], digits = 1), "%)")) +
  ylab(label = paste0(PC_y, " (", round(100 * var_explained[pc_chosen[2]], digits = 1), "%)")) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = viridis(12)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = viridis(12)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 18))

p2 <- ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = get(PC_x), y = get(PC_y))) +
  facet_wrap2(~Group, nrow = 1,
              strip = strip_nested(bleed = FALSE, background_x = background_fill,
                                   text_x = element_text(size = 16.5))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth=.2, col = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth=.2, col = "gray") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = `ICU.admission:.yes.or.no.or`), shape = 21, color = "black", size = 5) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(fill = "ICU admission") +
  xlab(label = paste0(PC_x, " (", round(100 * var_explained[pc_chosen[1]], digits = 1), "%)")) +
  ylab(label = paste0(PC_y, " (", round(100 * var_explained[pc_chosen[2]], digits = 1), "%)")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#4f7ebb", "#bc3d41")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4f7ebb", "#bc3d41")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 18))

p3 <- ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = get(PC_x), y = get(PC_y))) +
  facet_wrap2(~Group, nrow = 1,
              strip = strip_nested(bleed = FALSE, background_x = background_fill,
                                   text_x = element_text(size = 16.5))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth=.2, col = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth=.2, col = "gray") +

  xlab(label = paste0(PC_x, " (", round(100 * var_explained[pc_chosen[1]], digits = 1), "%)")) +
  ylab(label = paste0(PC_y, " (", round(100 * var_explained[pc_chosen[2]], digits = 1), "%)")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#4f7ebb", "#bc3d41")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4f7ebb", "#bc3d41")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 18))

pdf(file = "../figures/FigureS2B-CSF.pdf", width = 14, height = 3.47)
print(p1)
print(p2)
print(p3)
invisible(dev.off())

rm(data_pca, data_pca_input, data_pca_output, data_plot, mat_pca_input, p1,
   p2, p3, pca, var_explained, viable_markers, pc_chosen, PC_x, PC_y, background_fill) # cleanup
rm(list = ls(pattern = "rect_list_")) # cleanup
```

### Figure S2C-CSF

```{r}
pc_chosen <- c(1, 2) ### EDIT

PC_x <- paste0("PC", pc_chosen[1])
PC_y <- paste0("PC", pc_chosen[2])

### REFORMAT DATA
data_pca <- data_csf %>%
  dplyr::left_join(md, by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(PatientID %in% dual_run_patients_csf & Run == 2)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Neuropathy-no-GBS",
                                                 "Control-GBS",
                                                 "COVID-GBS",
                                                 "COVID-no-GBS"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("Zurich", "Bern",
                                                   "Hebron", "Santa Pau")))

### Select Markers for PCA with Below LOD Frequencies Below 30%
viable_markers <- data_pca %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Assay, NPX, LOD) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(belowLOD = if_else(NPX < LOD, 1, 0, NA_real_)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Assay) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    belowLOD_count = sum(belowLOD),
    total_count = n()
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(belowLOD_freq = 100 * belowLOD_count / total_count) %>%
  dplyr::filter(belowLOD_freq <= 30) %>%
  .$Assay

### Generate PCA Input Data
data_pca_input <- data_pca %>%
  dplyr::filter(Assay %in% viable_markers) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Cohort, Group, Assay, scaled_NPX) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "Assay", values_from = "scaled_NPX")

### Convert to Matrix
mat_pca_input <- data_pca_input %>%
  dplyr::select(c(PatientID, all_of(viable_markers))) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "PatientID") %>%
  as.matrix()

### Run PCA
pca <- prcomp(mat_pca_input)

### PCA Output
var_explained <- pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)

data_pca_output <- data.frame(PatientID=row.names(pca$x), pca$x)

### Plot PCA

  dplyr::left_join(md, by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(data_pca_input %>%
                     dplyr::select(PatientID) %>%
                     dplyr::distinct(),
                   by = "PatientID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("Zurich", "Bern", "Hebron", "Santa Pau"))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Group %in% c("COVID-GBS", "COVID-no-GBS"))

rect_list_3 <- rep(list(element_rect(fill = "#e34262")), 1)
# rect_list_4 <- rep(list(element_rect(fill = "#449489")), 1)
rect_list_5 <- rep(list(element_rect(fill = "white")), 1000) ### For the markers

# Combine the lists into a single list
background_fill <- c(rect_list_2, rect_list_3, rect_list_5) # rect_list_1, rect_list_4,


p1 <- ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = get(PC_x), y = get(PC_y))) +
  facet_wrap2(~Group, nrow = 1,
              strip = strip_nested(bleed = FALSE, background_x = background_fill,
                                   text_x = element_text(size = 16.5))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth=.2, col = "gray") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth=.2, col = "gray") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = `Hospitalized.due.to.COVID-19:.yes,.no,.,.unk.(=unknown)`), shape = 21, color = "black", size = 5) +

  ylab(label = paste0(PC_y, " (", round(100 * var_explained[pc_chosen[2]], digits = 1), "%)")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#4f7ebb", "#bc3d41")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4f7ebb", "#bc3d41")) +
  theme_bw() +
```
